Container.Name: mqtt-sim
Container.Overview: myH MQTT simulator: publishes test values from a CSV profile (and an optional GPS route) to an MQTT broker. Includes a web page to pick or upload profile and route CSVs, start/stop and watch live values. The built-in profile and route are examples.

Config.Name: Data folder
Config.Description: Your own profiles/ and routes/ (used before the built-in ones). examples/ is refreshed with the built-in files on every start.

Config.Name: Web page port
Config.Description: Web page: pick profiles and routes, upload CSVs from your PC, start/stop, live values

Config.Name: Broker user
Config.Description: HA user created for the simulator

Config.Name: Broker password
Config.Description: Password of the mqtt-sim HA user

Config.Name: Profile
Config.Description: Profile used on the very first start (afterwards the web page remembers your choice)

Config.Name: Route
Config.Description: Route used on the very first start (blank = no GPS); afterwards chosen on the web page

Config.Name: Repeat route
Config.Description: yes = start the route again when it ends

Config.Name: Victron portal ID
Config.Description: Your Victron portal ID (VRM → Settings → General); replaces {portal} in topics

Config.Name: Clear on stop
Config.Description: Remove retained test values when the container stops

Config.Name: Web page password
Config.Description: Optional: ask for this password (any user name) before showing the web page
